summary: Neff Gaming conducts 300 summons on the Option Summons banner selecting Dauntless and Thunderbolt factions. His primary goal is securing Nastjenka via the 300-summon selector to achieve Inspiration 5, which provides a massive performance boost to Dauntless and Vortex teams. During the summons, he pulls several legendaries including Stanguem, Tamar, Garett, Sutha, Bionphray, and Fathomdown. He highlights Thunderbolt as an essential secondary team for endgame bosses, Crown Contest, and Continental Challenge.

Thunderbolt faction heroes excel as a high-performing team in Continental Challenge, Crown Contest, and endgame bosses.

tips: Target key hero Inspiration levels (like Nastjenka I5) using the 300-summon selector on Option Summons banners.
Prioritize Thunderbolt heroes on option banners if you need a strong secondary team for endgame bossing and Crown Contest.
